answers.core: Button has the same feature, why not tree? Usually this is pretty basic feature in many GUI libraries.
answers.workaround:
Hiding is a possibility but it breaks the GUI view.

Workarounds are overall bad because visually the user still can edit the tree and might wonder why nothing happens. Therefore you need to have a lot of code to present some extra indicator that the selection is disabled and then backtrack the latest change after the `Tree` gets enabled again.

title: Add ability to disable `Tree` or prevent `Tree` selection
